The '''Large Gun/Warhead Emplacement''' was a strategic weapon emplacement produced by the [[Wandrau Arms Corporation]].

A modification of the more basic [[Large Gun Emplacement]] (and demanding a similar crew complement), this platform was also designed to augment a [[Space station/Legends|space station's]] existing defense systems, or protect stations and bases that were otherwise defenseless.

Equaling the Large Gun Emplacement's total of 16 omnidirectional [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] mounted in pairs, 8 on the upper and 8 on the lower part of the hull, this platform also boasted warhead launchers on both the top and base of the structure, equipped with a standard warhead load of 4 [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]. Perhaps due to the added systems required by these weapons, Wandrau fitted them with a far weaker [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield system]], only able to produce a tenth of the defensive capability of the Large Gun Emplacement. Furthermore, these systems somehow compromised hull armor (or the armor was omitted entirely), giving the Large Gun/Warhead Emplacement a paltry armor rating of 2 [[RU/Legends|RU]].

Nonetheless, this defense was extremely dangerous to incoming [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The warhead launchers also made it especially threatening to smaller [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], such as a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]].
